title: 교통 범칙금 고지서 읽기: 언제, 얼마를, 어디에 내요?
objective: You can find the date, place, violation, amount, and deadline on a traffic fine notice.
summary: Find the violation, amount, and deadline on a Korean traffic fine notice.
note: This is a sample notice. All names, numbers, and amounts are examples only.

task.title: Read and find information
task.line: Use the notice and word list on page 1 to answer each question in Korean.

items.gloss: date and time of the violation
items.text: It tells you when you broke the rule.
It tells you which rule you broke.
This is the amount of money you have to pay.
These are points added to your driving record.
This is the last day you can pay.
This bank account number is just for this fine.

steps.en: check your name and car number
find the amount and the deadline
choose bank, post office, or internet
send money to the account number

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Three common violations: 신호 위반 (going through a red light), 속도 위반 (driving too fast), 주정차 위반 (stopping or parking in a no-parking place).
Look at 납부 기한 first. If you pay late, the amount can go up. 까지 means 'by' or 'until', so 10월 20일까지 means you can still pay on October 20.

exercises: Read the notice and answer in Korean: [위반 일시] 2026. 10. 2. 08:40  [위반 장소] 바다로 사거리  [위반 내용] 속도 위반 ① 언제 위반했어요? ② 어디에서 위반했어요?
Write the type of violation (신호 위반 / 속도 위반 / 주정차 위반): ① 빨간불에 차가 지나갔어요. ② 차가 너무 빨리 달렸어요. ③ 차를 세우면 안 되는 곳에 차를 세웠어요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the notice: 범칙금은 40,000원이고 ____은 10점이에요.
The notice says 납부 기한: 2026년 10월 20일까지. Can you still pay on time? Write O or X: ① 오늘은 10월 18일이에요. ② 오늘은 10월 25일이에요.
answers: ① 2026년 10월 2일 오전 8시 40분이에요. ② 바다로 사거리에서 위반했어요.
① 신호 위반 ② 속도 위반 ③ 주정차 위반
